metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2003 · The Pianist
metas.description: During WWII, acclaimed Polish musician Wladyslaw faces various struggles as he loses contact with his family. As the situation worsens, he hides in the ruins of Warsaw in order to survive.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2004 · The Chorus
metas.description: Pierre, a successful orchestra conductor, returns home when his mother dies. He stumbles upon an old diary and recollects the childhood school memories and his music teacher Clement Mathieu.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2005 · Walk the Line
metas.description: A chronicle of country music legend Johnny Cash's life, from his early days on an Arkansas cotton farm to his rise to fame with Sun Records in Memphis, where he recorded alongside Elvis Presley, Jerry Lee Lewis, and Carl Perkins.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2007 · Once
metas.description: A modern-day musical about a busker and an immigrant and their eventful week in Dublin, as they write, rehearse and record songs that tell their love story.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2004 · Ray
metas.description: The story of the life and career of the legendary rhythm and blues musician Ray Charles, from his humble beginnings in the South, where he went blind at age seven, to his meteoric rise to stardom during the 1950s and 1960s.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2000 · Billy Elliot
metas.description: A talented young boy becomes torn between his unexpected love of dance and the disintegration of his family.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2001 · Hedwig and the Angry Inch
metas.description: A gender-queer punk-rock singer from East Berlin tours the U.S. with her band as she tells her life story and follows the former lover/band-mate who stole her songs.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2007 · Control
metas.description: A profile of Ian Curtis, the enigmatic singer of Joy Division whose personal, professional, and romantic troubles led him to die by suicide at the age of 23.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2005 · Joyeux Noel
metas.description: In December 1914, an unofficial Christmas truce on the Western Front allows soldiers from opposing sides of the First World War to gain insight into each other's way of life.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2007 · La Vie En Rose
metas.description: Biopic of the iconic French singer Édith Piaf. Raised by her grandmother in a brothel, she was discovered while singing on a street corner at the age of 19. Despite her success, Piaf's life was filled with tragedy.
